auth.description:
To generate your API credentials, follow the steps below:
1. Go to WooCommerce -> Settings -> Advanced tab -> REST API.
2. Click on Add Key to create a new key.
3. Enter the key description and change the permissions to Read/Write.
4. Click Generate Key.
5. Copy the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret into the fields below. You will not be able to view the Consumer Secret after exiting the page.

Note that the base URL of your WooCommerce instance needs to be on a secure (HTTPS) connection, or the piece will not work even on local instances on the same device.

baseUrl.description: The base URL of your app (e.g https://mystore.com) and it should start with HTTPS only

consumerKey.description: The consumer key generated from your app

consumerSecret.description: The consumer secret generated from your app

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new customer account in a WooCommerce store with email, name, username, password, and a billing/shipping address (the same address is applied to both). Use when an agent needs to register a shopper. Not idempotent: each call creates a new customer, and email and username must be unique in the store.

Creates a new discount coupon in a WooCommerce store with a code, discount type (fixed_cart, fixed_product, percent, or percent_product), amount, and minimum order amount. Use when an agent needs to issue a promotional or discount code. Not idempotent: each call posts a new coupon, and the code must be unique in the store.

images.description: Enter the URLs of images you want to upload (comma separated)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new product in a WooCommerce store with a name, type (simple, grouped, external, or variable), regular price, descriptions, category IDs, and image URLs (categories and images are comma-separated lists). Use when an agent needs to add a catalog item. Not idempotent: each call creates a new product.

Looks up customers in a WooCommerce store by exact email address. Use when an agent needs to resolve a shopper to their customer record or ID before referencing them. Read-only and idempotent. Requires the email; returns matching customers (empty if none match).

Retrieves a single product from a WooCommerce store by its numeric product ID. Use when an agent already has a product ID and needs the full product record (price, stock, status, etc.). Read-only and idempotent. Requires the exact product ID.

nl.\nTo generate your API credentials, foll:
Om uw API referenties te genereren, volg de onderstaande stappen:
1. Ga naar WooCommerce -> Instellingen -> Geavanceerd tabblad -> REST API.
2. Klik op Sleutel toevoegen om een nieuwe sleutel te maken.
3. Vul de beschrijving van de sleutel in en wijzig de rechten om te lezen/schrijven.
4. Klik op Sleutel genereren.
5. Kopieer de Consumer Key en Consumer Secret in de onderstaande velden. U kunt de Consumer Secret niet bekijken na het verlaten van de pagina.

Merk op dat de basis-URL van uw WooCommerce verbinding moet hebben met een beveiligde (HTTPS) verbinding. of het stuk zal zelfs niet werken op lokale instanties op hetzelfde apparaat.

de.\nTo generate your API credentials, foll:
Um Ihre API-Zugangsdaten zu generieren, folgen Sie den folgenden Schritten:
1. Gehen Sie zu WooCommerce -> Einstellungen -> Erweiterter Tab -> REST API.
2. Klicken Sie auf Schlüssel hinzufügen, um einen neuen Schlüssel zu erstellen.
3. Geben Sie die Schlüsselbeschreibung ein und ändern Sie die Berechtigungen zum Lesen/Schreiben.
4. Klicken Sie auf Schlüssel generieren.
Kopieren Sie den Verbraucherschlüssel und das Verbrauchergeheimnis in die untenstehenden Felder. Nach dem Verlassen der Seite können Sie das Verbrauchergeheimnis nicht mehr anzeigen.

Beachten Sie, dass die Basis-URL Ihrer WooCommerce-Instanz auf einer sicheren (HTTPS) Verbindung liegen muss oder das Stück funktioniert nicht einmal auf lokalen Instanzen auf demselben Gerät.
